task.description:
WF-03 Step 03 REWORK 2 (BACKEND-DEV) for GH-752/ISS-0692. DIAGNOSIS COMPLETE - no empirical sweep needed.

ROOT CAUSE: pg_advisory_lock acquisition fails because lock_timeout='90s' is too short. With -j8 and pool_size=2, the lock holder takes 60-90s for migrations; the 2nd-8th queuing binaries ALL exceed the 90s timeout. The pg library maps 55P03 (lock_timeout exceeded) to PgError.ServerError, producing the 118 ServerErrors observed in REWORK-1.

UNCOMMITTED CHANGES ALREADY IN WORKING TREE (prepared by previous agent):
- scripts/run-test-integration.ps1 and .sh: default cap 8->4
- tests/integration/helpers.zig: pool_size 2->4 in runMigrations() and runMigrationsForSchema()
- docs/guides/test_developer_guide.md: section 10.2 updated

MISSING PIECE: lock_timeout='90s' was NOT raised in the working-tree changes. With -j4 the math is: worst-case queue position 4, holder takes ~30-45s with pool_size=4, so 3x45=135s > 90s. Still fails.

DO EXACTLY THESE STEPS:

STEP A: In tests/integration/helpers.zig, change ALL occurrences of the advisory lock bracket from lock_timeout '90s' to '300s'. Run this to find them:
  grep -n "lock_timeout = '90s'" tests/integration/helpers.zig
Expect exactly 4 matches (approximately lines 127, 217, 929, 1156). Change each '90s' to '300s'. Do NOT change any other lock_timeout lines.

STEP B: Create tests/reports/ISS-0692-step03-rework2-sweep.md with a brief analysis documenting: (1) REWORK-1 observed 118 ServerErrors at -j8 pool_size=2 lock_timeout=90s; (2) root cause is lock_timeout=90s < queue_depth * migration_duration; (3) chosen fix: -j4 default, pool_size=4, lock_timeout=300s; (4) math: worst case 3*90s=270s < 300s with headroom. No additional empirical runs needed.

STEP C: Run `zig build` to verify compilation.

STEP D: Run `zig build test-env-verify`. Must exit 0, HEALTHY 10/10.

STEP E: Commit all working-tree changes on feature/WF03-GH752-20260812 with message: fix(tests): GH-752/ISS-0692 REWORK 2 - lower -j default to 4, pool_size 2->4, lock_timeout 90s->300s
Then push: git push origin feature/WF03-GH752-20260812

STEP F: Run the 5-consecutive-clean-run acceptance gate:
  powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scratch/wf03-gh752-5run-controller.ps1
This appends to tests/reports/ISS-0692-step05-runs.log and prints COMPLETE (PASS) or HALTED (FAIL).

If ALL 5 runs pass: set result.status=PASS in this handoff.
If any run fails with advisory-lock ServerError: report the exact lock_timeout value in effect and the failure count - do NOT attempt more sweeps.

CONSTRAINT: Do not make any other code changes. Do not run other test commands. Steps A-F only.j should be the empirically-determined best value. Document in scripts/run-test-integration.{ps1,sh} and docs/guides/test_developer_guide.md §10.2.

6. Commit on feature/WF03-GH752-20260812 with a clear message about what was tuned.

Acceptance criteria:
- Empirical sweep documented (with output) in tests/reports/ISS-0692-step03-rework2-sweep.md
- Chosen default -j value justified by the sweep
- If primary mitigation changed (e.g., pool size, timeout), that change is documented and the new mitigation's effect verified
- zig build test-env-verify still HEALTHY 10/10
- 5 consecutive clean runs achievable (Step 05 RETRY 2 will verify)
- tools/lint_handoffs.py exits 0
- Branch pushed

result.summary: Steps A-E completed cleanly (lock_timeout 90s->300s in 4 brackets, analysis report, zig build OK, test-env-verify HEALTHY 10/10, commit e268de76 pushed). Step F gate HALTED at RUN 1: ServerErrorCount=54, TRFR=2, lock_timeout='300s' in effect, -j4 default, pool_size=4.

issues.description: 5-run gate FAILED at RUN 1. ServerErrorCount=54 (vs 119 at -j8/90s in REWORK-1), TRFR=2. lock_timeout='300s' in effect; -j4 default; pool_size=4. Improvement: 54% reduction in ServerErrors, but still failing.

ROOT CAUSE (missed by REWORK-2 design): configureSessionTimeouts() sets statement_timeout='60s', which caps ALL advisory lock waits at 60s regardless of lock_timeout. With -j4 and migration time ~45s per binary, queue positions 3-4 wait >60s and are cancelled by statement_timeout (PG error 57014, also mapped to PgError.ServerError by pg.zig). lock_timeout='300s' alone is insufficient — statement_timeout must also be temporarily set to '0' or a large value in each advisory lock bracket before pg_advisory_lock() and restored immediately after.

Pre-existing gate failures unrelated to GH-752: (1) TC-RG-01 (gh512_t010_regression_test): T010 BLOCKER raw count=75, ceiling=74; (2) TC-RG-02: baseline total_issues=117, snapshot expects=116. These cause runExit!=0 even without the advisory lock issue. They were identified in RETRY-1 and should be filed as separate ISSes.

env-verify exit=1 despite HEALTHY 10/10 health output in the controller run. Likely PowerShell pipe interaction ($LASTEXITCODE after *>&1 | Tee-Object | Out-Null). Does not affect result since gate already fails for other reasons.

result.next_action: REWORK-3 (if dispatched): In addition to lock_timeout='300s', also set statement_timeout='0' (or BPM_TEST_STMT_TIMEOUT env fallback) immediately BEFORE each pg_advisory_lock() call in all 4 brackets in helpers.zig, then restore it to '60s' after the lock is acquired. This ensures the pg_advisory_lock wait is bounded by lock_timeout only (300s), not by statement_timeout (60s). Alternatively consider -j2 which reduces max queue position to 1, so wait ~45s < 60s statement_timeout and the current fix would already work.
